_lisez_moi: File text (public/js/dossier-regles.js, dossier-parcours.js): documents to gather, steps, file status. Same keys as src/contenu/fr/dossier.json.

items.pv-ag: Minutes of shareholder meetings for the last 3 years
items.capital: Shareholding structure and any shareholders’ agreement

items.liasses: Tax returns and annual accounts for the last 3 fiscal years
items.situation: Interim statements for the current fiscal year
items.emprunts: Details of loans, lease financing and guarantees given

items.accords: Company agreements and applicable collective bargaining agreement

items.baux: Commercial leases and any title deeds

alerte_plancher: Part of the range is below the adjusted net assets, which serve as a floor in negotiations.

ecart.sur_ebe: calculation based on EBITDA (EBE) instead of revenue

chiffres.detail: The only required fiscal year: the valuation is based on it

questions.detail: Short screens, most of them one click

redaction.detail: Valuation, teaser and memorandum, in one go

exercices.detail: A buyer reasons over three years; you can also skip this step

photo.titre_premiere: Add a photo of the workshop or the products
photo.detail_premiere: Memorandum recommendation: it brings the “Know-how” page to life
photo.titre_seconde: Add a photo of the team or the site

titre_choisir.one: Choose your photo: 1 found on your website
titre_choisir.other: Choose your photos: {n} found on your website

photo.detail_choisir: They illustrate the memorandum’s cover, business and team pages.

retraitements.titre: Adjust your accounts: pay, rent, one-off items
retraitements.detail: The adjustment that weighs most on the value

dette.titre: Enter your net debt and the scope of the sale
dette.detail: What separates the value of the company from that of your shares

valeur.detail: The full calculation, line by line
valeur.detail_calculee: Calculated: {fourchette}; to check line by line

photos.titre: Choose your logo and your photos
photos.detail: Those from your website, or your own

equipe.detail: A page of the memorandum, never in the teaser

documents.calculee_redaction: Calculated at the Drafting step, with your answers.
documents.debloque_chiffres_reponses: Calculated at the “Your value” step, after your adjustments and your debt.
documents.debloque_exercice: Unlocks as soon as a fiscal year is confirmed.
documents.redige_redaction: Drafted at the Drafting step, after your answers.
documents.apres_validation: Drafted once your figures are approved

valeur.base_titres: Based on your industry’s EBITDA (EBE) multiples, after debt and cash.
valeur.base_express: Estimated from the latest public accounts and industry multiples, before debt and cash; your figures will refine it.
valeur.base_aucune: The public accounts are not enough for a first estimate: your figures will make it possible.
valeur.base_titres_a_valider: Calculated from your figures, after debt and cash; check it line by line, then approve it.

final.pret_aide: Review each document before sharing it. You can edit everything.
final.non_pret_aide: It isn’t ready to send yet: {pct}% complete. Here’s what’s left.

redige_reste.one: Your file is drafted: {n} step left
redige_reste.other: Your file is drafted: {n} steps left

relire_detail: Your documents are written. Review the memorandum, then choose who to send it to.
relire_detail_non_redige: See what’s ready and what’s left before sending.

ancc.dans: The adjusted net assets ({ancc}) fall within the range ({bas} – {haut}): asset value and earnings value agree.
ancc.plancher: The adjusted net assets ({ancc}) are below the whole range ({bas} – {haut}): they serve as a floor in negotiations.
ancc.au_dessus: Asset value above earnings value: the adjusted net assets ({ancc}) exceed the range from the multiples ({bas} – {haut}). Your company is worth more for what it owns than for what it earns. Prepare this argument for the negotiation with your advisor: which assets explain the gap (ample cash, real estate, inventory) and how to have them recognized, in the price or outside it.
ancc.negatif: The adjusted net assets are negative ({ancc}): they do not support the value, which rests entirely on profitability.
